# kind -- Kubernetes-in-Docker local clusters

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Install files | `charly.yml` (binary fetch + engine-prepare script) |
| Pinned version | `v0.33.0` (edit `KIND_VERSION` in `var:` to cut over) |
| Binaries | `/usr/local/bin/kind`, plus `kubectl`/`helm` from the required client candy |
| Depends on | `/charly-coder:kubernetes-layer` (kubectl + helm) |

## What this candy does

Installs the pinned, sha256-verified kind release binary (from the Arch
`kind` package on Arch, the upstream release asset elsewhere) plus a
`kind-engine-prepare` script that makes the resolved container engine ready
for kind's node containers.

**kind is host tooling.** It provisions local Kubernetes clusters as
*node containers* on the operator's container engine, so it is composed by
a `target: local` deploy on the host (or a box that runs kind inside).

## Engine selection — KIND_EXPERIMENTAL_PROVIDER

The engine is charly's own engine word (`podman`/`docker`/`nerdctl`), which
maps 1:1 to kind's `KIND_EXPERIMENTAL_PROVIDER`. The `kindcluster:` deploy's
`engine:` field (or the resolved `engine.run`) drives it; there is no
separate selector.

## Per-engine preconditions (all handled by kind-engine-prepare)

| Engine | Precondition |
|--------|--------------|
| `docker` | A reachable daemon (rootless or rootful). Nothing else. |
| rootless `podman` | cgroup v2 + a log driver kind can tail (`k8s-file`); raised pids/inotify limits. |
| rootless `nerdctl` | Rootless containerd running (`containerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install`). |

kindnet is kind's CNI; there is **no Traefik and no ServiceLB**, so the
`kube: addons` check verb (which waits on the k3s addon stack) does NOT
apply to a kind cluster — use `nodes`/`wait-nodes`/`pods`/`wait-ready`/
`storageclass`/`raw` instead. The StorageClass is `standard`
(rancher local-path, in the `local-path-storage` namespace).

## The `kindcluster:` substrate

The candy is the host-tooling leg of the `kindcluster` substrate. A
`kindcluster:` template provisions the cluster (engine / `node_image` /
`nodes`); a `from:` deploy runs an optional workload applied with
`kubectl apply -k`. The word is `kindcluster`, NOT `kind` — the bare word
collides with the schema's own `source: {kind: …}` discriminator and with
kind's own `kind: Cluster` config field.

## Loading a local image

kind nodes have their own image store, separate from the host engine's. A
locally-built image must be loaded in — and `kind load docker-image` is
BROKEN on podman (measured: "image not present locally" despite the image
existing). The provider uses the engine-agnostic `kind load image-archive`
path, so it works on docker, podman, and nerdctl.

## Teardown

`kind delete cluster --name <cluster>` — engine-scoped (the provider sets
`KIND_EXPERIMENTAL_PROVIDER`, since `kind get/delete cluster` is
engine-scoped: names are unique only WITHIN an engine), and idempotent on a
missing cluster.

## Usage

```yaml
# charly.yml -- the host tooling profile
kind-host:
  local:
    candy:
      - kind

# a kindcluster template + deploy (see /charly-kubernetes:kubernetes)
kind-lab-cluster:
  kindcluster:
    engine: podman
    node_image: kindest/node:v1.37.0@sha256:a1ed56cfb0e7b93589bdf97c8cd566405a265939e3620fc4f5de89adff580ae5
    nodes:
      - role: control-plane
        extra_port_mappings:
          - container_port: 30080
            host_port: 30080
      - role: worker

kind-lab:
  kindcluster:
    from: kind-lab-cluster
    image: my-app          # optional workload, applied via `kubectl apply -k`
    disposable: true       # if it is a check bed
```

```bash
charly deploy add kind-host --target local     # install kind on the host
charly deploy add kind-lab  --target kindcluster
kubectl --context kind-lab get nodes
```

## Tests

Build-scope: `kind version` matches the pin; `/usr/local/bin/kind` is
mode 0755; the node-image pin file content; the engine-prepare script is
executable and `sh -n` clean; `kubectl version --client` exits 0.
